note: PUR-RECOVER V2 is an orchestration version, not a science version. Every scoring rule (columns, hard_constraints, objective, robustness, backward, local_trends) is still inherited verbatim from configs/frontier_v1.json at load time, the anonymization seed is unchanged, and the evaluator gold is identical to V1. Only the Agent contract changes: claim-level evidence planning, counterfactual challenge, dual-path verification, canonical constraint ontology and a machine-computed decision certificate.

ontology.note: Frozen before the V2 formal matrix and applied identically to every V2 condition. It renames no pur_science field and is never applied retroactively to V1 records.

evaluation.cross_path_tolerance_rationale: Both admissible derivations are exact on the frozen linear MDI-demand manifold, so the agreement tolerance is numerical, not scientific. It is deliberately far tighter than the 0.03 gold-recovery tolerance and is not a second chance to be scored correct.

secondary_benchmarks.named_chemistry: build with --no-anonymize to test performance with domain priors; never the primary result
